I was really excited to try these since everyone says they're great for sensitive skin — but honestly, they were a disappointment for me. Shortly after applying, my under-eyes started itching and burning — not just a little, but noticeable within 5 minutes. Definitely not what I expected from something labeled "sensitive skin friendly." The patches themselves felt super dry and didn't seem to have enough serum on them at all. I didn't experience the complaint about patches not sticking — these stuck just fine because the gel is very tacky — but the experience overall wasn't good. I generally love Patchology products, which is why this let-down was even more surprising. The design is cute, but unfortunately that's where the positives end for me.

avis.titre: Been reviewing a lot of eye patches to find a perfect one!
avis.texte: These are just, NO! Cheaper, better options out there!.. I made it through the whole sample pack because I spent money on them, but I have no idea how people like these?!!.. I cleanse & tone & prep first, but like others have said, they are slimy and slippery and slide down your face constantly unless you're laying down! Hence why I like the beauty sleep ones only. And every single pack is cut uneven so they sit weird under the eyes! And majority of them had rips in them straight out of the package, which became extremely hard to work with!!.. if I can get them to stay up then they do honestly illuminate some of my under eyes and make them look more awake, which is the only reason I gave them two stars!!but I am extremely glad I did not spend the money on a whole pack of these and got the same pack on sale!
